scope: Synthetic host-only numerical recovery; not authorized-work or model-native communication
arithmetic: IEEE binary64 scalar, no FMA, round-nearest-even hardware arithmetic; message quantization ties-away-from-zero (not Wolfram Round tie behavior; no tie in fixed G0)
loss: sum of four squared feature residuals
update: explicit derivative, online SGD lr1/10,2000 epochs,ascending input ID order,no schedule or early stopping; staged finite check then atomic commit
initialization: xorshift32(seed), shifts13,17,5; each parameter=(rng mod33-16)/64; zero biases are NOT assumed

splits.1: even parity IDs0,3,5,6,9,10,12,15 train;odd IDs1,2,4,7,8,11,13,14 test

arms.2: first three Hadamard rows then softsign,encoder frozen,receiver learned
arms.3: direct four-bit semantic discrete code in one byte,no learned dictionary,no training
arms.4: learned sender/receiver with seeded Fisher-Yates shuffled training labels;score against original meanings

perturbations.5-12: EXPLORATORY fixed eight sign corners of additive1/32,not primary or tuned
perturbations.16: mask third continuous coordinate or fourth discrete bit
perturbations.17: mask second/third continuous coordinates or third/fourth discrete bits

context: 1=trained receiver bias;0=zero receiver bias. This ablates learned bias only,not arbitrary shared agent state.
admission: continuous message count exactly3,all finite,abs<=1;refuse atomically otherwise
decision: bit threshold score>=1/2;abstain flag if any score has abs(score-1/2)<1/10 or malformed. Predictions retained separately;abstention is not a correct recovery.
result_schema: CSV R,seed,split,arm,input_id,perturbation,context,h0_bits,h1_bits,h2_bits,p0_bits,p1_bits,p2_bits,p3_bits,pred0,pred1,pred2,pred3,abstained,encoder_ns,decoder_ns,status. IEEE doubles are unsigned decimal64bit carriers. Baseline arm3 logs discrete input ID as f64 carrier in h0 for observability;this is not its one-byte wire representation.
timing_schema: CSV T,seed,split,arm,training_ns;timestamps descriptive host diagnostics only,not Spark/GPU throughput
cost_boundary: Charge all encoder and receiver coefficients,biases,compiled code,shared basis,dictionaries,quantization metadata,source/transport schema,training and inference separately. Logged CSV is not a wire protocol;no measured economic win. Missing memory,DRAM,energy,network,verification and authorized-work costs remain NOT_MEASURED/NOT_RUN.
reveal_rule: Commit exact source/config before running. Never tune from parity-heldout outcomes;preserve all seeds and failures. Public parity cases are reproducibility control,not NL6 secret confirmatory campaign.
